in_marathi.name: Bheemika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bheemika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bheema’ meaning ‘strong’ or ‘powerful’. In Hindu mythology, Bheemika refers to the name of a powerful character in the Mahabharata known for his strength and bravery.
